name: Jajang C. Noer
bio: Jajang C. Noer (also known as Jajang Pamuntjak, born as Lidia Djunita Pamontjak on June 28, 1952 in Paris, France) is an Indonesian actress and film producer. She is also the only daughter of Indonesian national independence movement figure Nazir Datuk Pamoentjak.  She won the best supporting actress category at the Indonesian Film Festival in 1992 for her role in Mer's Lips. She was married to Arifin C. Noer, an Indonesian film director who died in May 1995.
